messages:
maria: customer hit 400s on /v1/rerank intermittently. they say it only fails from mobile app behind our proxy. response body: \"error: invalid request - 'items' must be a non-empty array\"

john: any request id or example payload? can you paste raw request headers+body (sanitized) so we can repro?

maria: pasted headers (sanitized) and body below. Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...
Body (as sent by app proxy):
```
{
  \"payload\": \"[{\n    \"id\": \"abc123\",\n    \"query\": \"foo\",\n    \"candidates\": []\n  }]\"\n}
```
(note: the app wraps the array into a JSON string inside a field named `payload`)

support-bot: [auto] New support ticket created: TKT-4721 (maria)

alex: looks like double-encoding + envelope. our API expects top-level `items` (array) or `requests` depending on client. if customer sends an enveloped JSON string in a form field the server will parse top-level object and see `payload` (string) not `items` -> validation fails with \"missing items\" or items empty.

lina: which SDK version are they using? some older mobile SDKs used form-encoding fallback for big payloads.

maria: they're on mobile-sdk-2.3.1. proxy is doing some transformation for retries; i suspect it stringifies and posts as form data. repro steps I used locally:
```bash
# reproduces the 400 we see in logs
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary\" \
  -d $'{\"payload\":\"[{\\\"id\\\":\\\"abc\\\",\\\"query\\\":\\\"hi\\\",\\\"candidates\\\":[]}]\"}'
```

john: yep repro'd here. server returns 400 + message \"items must be an array\". if you instead send `Content-Type: application/json` with body like:
```json
{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"abc\",\"query\":\"hi\",\"candidates\":[{\"text\":\"a\"}]}]}
```
it succeeds.

alex: short-term fix: advise customer to post JSON (application/json) and not form-encoded wrapper. long-term: add a clearer error in validation layer explaining envelope detected and giving example snippet. also check if our ALB/proxy rewrites bodies for mobile user-agent.

maria: added note to customer with example curl + suggested SDK upgrade to 2.4.0. they asked if we can accept enveloped `payload` fields — is that safe to tolerate?

lina: tolerating arbitrary stringified arrays opens us up to more parsing complexity and edge cases (charset, BOM, escape sequences). if we do, enforce max length and strict JSON parse + validation. prefer to push proper Content-Type.

alex: created an internal tracking item in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/issues/2983 - we can consider a 400 message improvement in the short term (V patch).

maria: customer confirmed that switching to application/json fixed it. closing on their side. adding notes to TKT-4721 and linking GH issue. :thumbsup:

john: putting a quick KB entry in docs/support with common proxy envelope repro steps and the curl examples.

maria: thanks all, will follow up if they hit related variants (e.g., candidates as comma-separated strings).

alex: FYI - also saw one case where clients sent `topK` as string e.g. \"5\" which bypassed some client-side validation and led to weird ranking results. will add a checklist for support triage.
